Paragraph: In Bhagavad Gita Chapter 9, Verse 22, Krishna makes a comforting promise: 'For those who always worship Me with exclusive devotion, meditating on My divine form, I personally carry what they lack and preserve what they have.'
Situation/Problem_Faced: Scarcity mindset, chronic anxiety about future security, feelings of inadequacy, and financial stress.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Krishna offers divine assurance (Yogakshema), promising that sincere trust and effort attract divine support and care.
Outcome/Resolution: Releasing financial and survival anxieties fosters deep peace, trust, and security.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Yoga-Kshema (Divine assurance of provision and protection)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Single-minded devotion brings divine protection, ensuring that genuine spiritual and material needs are met.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Relieves survival anxiety and resource scarcity dread by encouraging trust and cognitive grounding.
